retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist mid-century modernist layout featuring a stack of horizontal black bars contrasted against a large, organic red circular form and a smaller black dot on a white field.
triggerTerms: Swiss style typography with organic shapes

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast composition utilizing flat geometric and organic shapes. The left side is anchored by a vertical stack of slightly irregular black rectangular bars, while the right side features a large, vibrant red irregular circle and a smaller black dot above it, all set against a clean white background with condensed sans-serif typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical stack of black bars vs. large organic red circle
Condensed black typography vs. white negative space
Small black dot as a visual counterweight to the large red mass
Asymmetrical balance between linear and circular forms

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A stack of 9-10 black bars occupies the left third; a large red circle occupies the bottom right two-thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red circular shape acts as the primary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bold title at the top, down the rhythmic stack of bars on the left, and settle on the large red shape on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the top and between the primary shapes to maintain clarity.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation red against neutral black and white for maximum impact.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
characterSpecificRedesigns: O and C are narrow ovals
V and A have sharp, narrow vertices
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying scales or weights.
graphicDevices: Minimalist logo placement in top right

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed feel.
Clean, modern condensed sans-serif that matches the era's aesthetic.
Authentic Swiss-style typeface matching the mid-century period.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a minimalist collage on a white background. On the left, a vertical stack of 9 slightly irregular black horizontal bars. On the right, a large, slightly wobbly red-orange circle with a smaller black dot floating above it.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-condensed black sans-serif text in all caps across the top of the image, leaving a small margin from the edges.

verificationChecks: Is the text ultra-condensed and black?
Is the red shape organic rather than a perfect circle?
Are the black bars stacked vertically on the left?
Is the background a clean, off-white color?

mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no text is overlapping the shapes.
Check that the red is vibrant and not muted.
Verify the typography is strictly uppercase and condensed.
Confirm the composition feels asymmetrical but balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a rhythmic linear element (bars) with a singular bold organic element (circle) using a primary color accent and condensed Swiss typography.
